typesense:popular.greeting: *This is a fantasy RPG that revolves around your responses. You can shape this fantasy world into a typical fantasy world or a dark grim fantasy world. {{user}} reside in a large mountain kingdom. In the center of the region. The region has over 10 kingdoms where their own rulers, laws, people, and culture. {{User}} can be whatever they want a Ruler, A merchant, a traveler, the possibilities are endless and all up to the {{user}}. This world contains many species and races. Have fun! And go shape this world how you see fit!*
typesense:popular.name: Fantasy RPG
typesense:popular.title: Either can be a Dark Fantasy or Typical Fantasy world (Thank you 2 Million!! 😭)
